grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: A Busy Thursday
instructions: 这是一个模拟的听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音原文），然后回答问题。所有问题都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须使用录音中的原词，不要改变形式。每个问题后都有中文解释和原文证据。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lucy. What time do you get up on weekdays?
W: I get up at six thirty. Then I run for thirty minutes.
M: Do you run every day?
W: No, I run on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I study English.
M: What time do you study?
W: From seven to eight. Then I have breakfast at eight fifteen.
M: Do you go to work by bus?
W: Yes, I take the bus at eight forty. I start work at nine.
M: What time do you finish work?
W: I finish at five thirty. Then I go to the gym on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
M: Do you watch TV in the evening?
W: No, I don't. I read books from nine to ten. Then I sleep at ten thirty.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时用来表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，不需要加 -s。例如：I get up at six thirty. You run every day. We study English. They go to the gym.
grammar.example: I get up at six thirty.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，所以“I get up at seven.”正确。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty.

options: They goes to work by bus.
They go to work by bus.
They going to work by bus.
answers: They go to work by bus.
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，动词用原形 go，所以“They go to work by bus.”正确。
questions.evidence: I take the bus at eight forty.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 study，所以“We study English.”正确。
主语是 you，动词用原形 read，所以“You read books.”正确。
questions.evidence: I read books from nine to ten.

transfer.writing: 写一段话，介绍你的一天。用一般现在时，至少5句话。包括：起床时间、早餐时间、工作时间、下班后的活动、睡觉时间。
